chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: In almost all Gen AI engineer job postings, you will find one common skill, Retrieval

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Augmented Generation also known as RAG.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: In my company at Lake, when we build AI projects for our clients, more than 40% of these projects

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: have RAG component in it.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So what exactly is RAG?

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: What are different types?

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Is Naive RAG dead due to Vectorless RAG?

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: We are going to cover all these RAG basics in a very simple and intuitive language.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: We will not just talk theory, I will show you a RAG project which is a customer care

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: chatbot in telecom domain.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: In the end, I will share some useful resources including RAG interview questions.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Alright let's get started.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Let's understand RAG using a simple example.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: When you ask chatGPT a policy question for some private company, it won't be able to

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: answer it because chatGPT is trained on general internet knowledge.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: It doesn't know the HR policy details of any private company.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: But if you give HR policy document to this LLM which acts like a brain, it should be

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: able to read a relevant section and provide you with the answer.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: This is similar to having a very smart student Mira who is a computer science student and

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: you are asking her to appear in a microbiology exam which is an open book exam.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Now Mira is generally good in terms of reading, writing, comprehension, understanding etc.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: But she doesn't know anything about microbiology.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: But in this exam, she has been given a book on microbiology from which they are going

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: to ask the questions.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Now Mira can use her reading, writing, comprehension skills to look at the book and she can write

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: answers in the exam.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So here Mira's brain is like LLM which has a good understanding of language, it has reasoning

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: capabilities and the book is like an HR policy document.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: It is an external knowledge where LLM can look into it and pull the answers.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Let's now understand the two-step process of how rag works underneath.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So here I have HR policy document from atlic which will have a section on retirement benefits.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So now if I go to chatGPT and if I copy this particular section and I ask my question related

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: to contribution to employees retirement fund.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: In that case, chatGPT will be able to answer that question because here you are asking

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: question and providing knowledge as a reference in the context and it can pull the answer.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: But what if your HR policy document is 3000 page PDF?

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: What if that knowledge is very big?

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: What's going to happen in that case is you will run out of your context window limit

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: and even if you have a huge context window, you should still not feed the entire knowledge

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: because it will be too many tokens.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: It will be costly.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So what people do is they will chunk this document.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So they will create let's say basic strategy is fixed size chunks and then for a given

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: question you can pull the relevant chunks.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So for this particular question, let's say my first chunk is 70% probability that it

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: will contain the answer.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Second chunk is 60% match and you can have by the way I'm showing just three but you

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: can have 1000 chunks and some of the chunks might have 5% or even 10% possibility that

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: it may contain the answer.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Let's say the chunk contains information on when Atleek was founded, culture, founders,

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: etc.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Then that doesn't have anything to do with the retirement question that you are asking.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So the relevance of that chunk will be very low.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Now how do you exactly find this kind of similarity?

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So there is this concept of embedding.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So embedding is a process of converting text into a vector such that it can represent its

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: meaning.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So of all the chunks you will convert them into vector embeddings and then you will store

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: them into a vector database.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: This is different than your regular database.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Your regular database can search using exit values whereas vector database will be able

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: to search using the meaning.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So when you search for let's say a company that is a leader in electric vehicle it will

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: return Tesla from the database.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So it is searching based on the meaning not based on the exit word.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: To generate embedding you can use variety of models sentence transformer text embedding

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: three small and so on and there are many vector database choices that you have in market

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: millworth quadrant chroma db and so on.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: This step is called indexing.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: This is the first step in rack process where you are indexing all these vectors of chunks

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: into a vector database.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: The second step is retrieval where for a given question you will generate embedding using

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: the same embedding model.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Then you will try to find the relevant chunks in a vector database.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So here it is doing the semantic search giving you a relevant vectors.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: You can specify top k factor.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Let's say I need two chunks or five chunks and so on and then you will generate the actual

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: text out of those chunks and you will put it in your prompt along with the question

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: and when the question is given to llm it will give you the answer.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So here below the question what you are doing is you are providing only the relevant chunks.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So this way llm will not hallucinate and it will give you accurate answer.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: That takes us into our next segment which is the two major benefits of rag.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: The first one is the answers that you get will be highly accurate and the chances of

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: hallucination will reduce because you are grounding your responses in the knowledge

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: in the source of truth.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Second it is very cost effective because if you pass the entire context then you are sending

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: too many tokens to llm and these llm apis they charge you per token.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So if you send less number of tokens only the relevant knowledge then you will save

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: money on your api bill.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Here is a hands-on customer care assistant rag project.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: I have given the code in the video description below.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: You can ask different questions.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: For example why is my mobile internet slow and it will find the answer based on the knowledge

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: that it has.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So the knowledge is stored in terms of the troubleshooting pdf file.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So here is the pdf file and let's say you have this question on how do you want to enable

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: the LTE then it is pulling that answer from this particular pdf file.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: The other source is the csv file containing all the FAQs and the third source is a SQLite

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: database containing all the past tickets.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Here we are using chroma db as vector database.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So we are ingesting FAQs then pdf and tickets into chroma db.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So these are the three files which is ingesting into a vector database.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: If you look at ingest pdf here we are using the chunk size of 600 overlap of 100.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: We are using recursive character text printer strategy and for embedding we are using this

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: particular embedding model from hugging face.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: As a framework we have used lang chain.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Now the retriever will try to find relevant chunks from FAQ tickets or guides.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: In terms of LLM we are using quen from chat grok.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Please download the project on your computer try to run it to enhance your understanding

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: on rack concepts.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Telecom support chatbot that we just saw is an example of enterprise QA chatbots.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: There are many other industry use cases for rack.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: For example you can build medical knowledge assistant which can look at the vast amount

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: of medical knowledge and pulls a relevant answer for your query.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: The other one is legal and compliance tools.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Once again here the knowledge will be your legal documents and you want to pull the most

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: relevant and accurate answer.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: HR chatbot is another example.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Let's now look at rack categories.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: The first one is a vector rack and naive rag is the example that we just saw where you

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: pull the top k relevant chunks from a vector database and answer users question.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: The second category is vector less rag in which you can perform a keyword rag.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So here you are not generating any vector embeddings.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: You don't have a vector database but you are using keyword match or techniques like bm25

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: tfidf etc to query into the document using the exact keywords.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: This method will work when you have a lot of codes, jargons, IDs, citations.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Let's say you are doing research and you are always searching using some particular ID

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: or a particular keyword then this will work.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: This is weak for semantic understanding when you are not doing exact keyword matching and

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: searching using meaning.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: This is not a good choice and the key tools that uses keyword rag concepts like bm25 is

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: elastic search and apache solar.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: The next category in vector rag is hybrid rag where you are combining vector search

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: and keyword search.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Okay.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: You do both of these in parallel and merge the results.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: This is based for most of the production systems.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: The key tools here are elastic search plus any vector db.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Now in atlick we worked on one rag project for our client where we have developed our

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: own custom hybrid method for doing rag and we have given details of this approach in

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: a different video.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: You can check it out if you are interested.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Also if you want to learn AI engineering by building production grade AI systems similar

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: to the projects that I just mentioned then check our AI engineering cohort where we have

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: live sessions on weekends and we will teach you all the concepts plus you will build 8

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: plus production grade projects.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: The next category in vectorless rag is a graph rag.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: It is also known as kg rag.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So here you will generate a knowledge graph.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So let's say your knowledge is Elon Musk and all the companies he has founded.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So in that case you will build this kind of knowledge graph where you will say Elon Musk

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: founded Tesla, SpaceX, Neuralink, OpenAI and so on.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: And then these companies will be operating in this different domain.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So these are all the entities and they are connected through some kind of relationship.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Now when you ask a question which companies are founded by Elon Musk which are working

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: in AI you will traverse this particular path.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So you will look at all the companies and then you will do breadth first traversal and

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: you will find that OpenAI is working in AI.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: The next one is SQL rag.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: This is also known as text to SQL.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: This method is very simple.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Let's say you have sales database which contains the sales of products.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Now you are asking this question which product sold the most last month.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Using LLM you can first generate a query for that database.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: You will execute the query, get the results and then give it back to LLM to generate a

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: comprehensive answer.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: You are taking a sentence in a natural language converting it to SQL using LLM and putting

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: a query in your database to get the results.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: And the last method which is relatively new is called page index.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: It is reasoning based rag.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So here let's say you have 3000 page PDF document.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: First you will generate the table of content.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: The table of content or your information structure.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: This is like you are having a book and you are having all the chapter and topic layout.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Now when somebody asks this question what does the contract say about compensation for

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: breach of contract?

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: The LLM will use its reasoning capability and this particular table of content to traverse

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: this particular graph and locate the thing that it is looking for.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So for example in this case it will first find out that this is related to performance

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: of contracts because the contract is already executed.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So it has to be related to this and then it finds compensation of breach.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So it goes from here to here and then you are discussing loss.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So due to that it will out of all these nodes it will go to this particular node and it

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: will pull the relevant document.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Now this might give you an index and using index you might have to refer back to the

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: original knowledge.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So here is a GitHub for page index.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: It is known as vectorless reg but it is one of the categories of vectorless reg.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Okay.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: The right term is reasoning based reg.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So here you can see from document you are generating a tree which is your knowledge

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: tree structure index of documents and then LLM will do its reasoning to find the relevant

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: chunk.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Here you are not using any vectors.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: You are not using any embeddings.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: No vector db.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Just by looking at the structure you know the table layout which looks something like

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: this.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: You will try to find a given node.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Okay.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: And see here there is a summary.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So using the summary LLM can reason and it can say okay maybe the answer is in this particular

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: node and then it will go to that node refer to the original document and pull the answer.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: I have attached this PDF in the video description below where you have categories of reg.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: You also have a table comparing when to use what.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: It is not that reasoning reg is here so you should not use naive reg.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: You should use it when you have general text, QnA boards etc. and the complexity here is

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: low.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: The complexity in case of page index is high.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: You should use it when you have hierarchical tree index, LLM traversal.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: You know these are the use cases.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So you can use this table to determine when to use what kind of reg and then we have reg

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: interview questions.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: Alright folks.

chunks.title: RAG Explained  All about RAG
chunks.text: So please check it out.
